dimensions.notes: Retains the supplied finite nonempty component family, extended pseudometrics without separation, isolated absorbing point and total absorbing-preserving operators. All estimate pairs are explicitly in the effective domain. Domain truncation and composition domains are proved, and all additional finite-distance or independent-visibility hypotheses are expressly scoped. No point-set injectivity or inverse is inferred from pseudometric lower bounds.

Genuine jointly summed row-output/column-input certificates u<=L+v are defined with exact quantifiers. Matrix semiring operations, order closure, row decomposition, convexity, identity, constant-operator example, restriction and correctly ordered upper-composition law are proved. The infinity/zero example preserves component dependence and does not mistake individual pairwise certificates for joint sums.

Defines compatible joint lower certificates L-v<=u, not reciprocals. Proves zero feasibility, downward closure, convexity, directed-sup closure and maximal elements; actual-domain lower-composition law, independent-visibility upper/lower comparison and distinguishability reflection all have the necessary hypotheses. The reflection is explicitly only zero-distance reflection, with no claim of a well-defined inverse or quotient injection absent zero-preservation.

Explicit 0*infinity=0 arithmetic is used consistently throughout. Upper and threshold feasibility are proved equivalent to whole-zero-input preservation, so arbitrary nonseparating operators are not assumed to have certificates. Empty effective comparison sets are vacuous under the explicit universal definitions and every displayed theorem remains valid. The infinite-input scalar (0,infinity] example correctly refutes attainment of the upper infimum; duplicate-component examples rule out a universal least upper or greatest lower matrix. Directed lower-sup closure is valid for extended inputs, while upper-inf closure and minimal elements are explicitly restricted to finite input distances. Zorn and finite-coordinate directed-limit arguments apply in exactly those scopes.

Closed threshold-row boxes imply output pseudodistance zero, never equality of points. Uses the admissible threshold SET rather than an unjustified maximal radius; [0,1) example explicitly proves an unattained closed-threshold endpoint. Proves feasibility/zero-preservation equivalence, downward closure, collapse equivalence and identity threshold E_diamond. Threshold composition, mixed pullback and local-ball collapse correctly keep actual-domain conditions and extended endpoints, including infinity.

All substantive displayed identities and inequalities are mutually consistent. The diamond operation has exactly the associative law and LEFT identity actually stated in3.4; its general right identity is never asserted. The kappa formula, antitonicity, multiplicativity and image of the unit are proved correctly (its {0,infinity}-valued image is unital). Product laws, support duality, lower/threshold exclusion and ball collapse have closed proofs. No reference-specific affine correction, OET notation or optional extra theory is required.
